actions.tous_les_indicateurs_de_ton_metier_dde4: All the indicators for your business are already tracked.

bce_facilite_depot.label: Deposit facility rate (ECB)
bce_facilite_depot.description: The euro area’s benchmark policy rate: what the ECB pays banks on their deposits. The date is that of the latest decision.

bce_refinancement.label: Main refinancing operations rate (ECB)
bce_refinancement.description: The rate at which banks refinance for one week with the ECB. The date is that of the latest decision.

estr.label: €STR (euro short-term rate)
estr.description: The overnight rate of the euro interbank market, published every morning by the ECB.

fr_inflation_ipc.label: Inflation in France (CPI, year on year)
fr_inflation_ipc.description: The rise in consumer prices over twelve months, all households, France — INSEE’s benchmark index (2025 base).

fr_irl.label: Rent reference index (IRL)
fr_irl.description: The quarterly index that caps the annual revision of residential rents.

fr_irl_variation.label: Annual change in the IRL
fr_irl_variation.description: The maximum increase for a residential rent revised this quarter, as a percentage year on year.

fr_prix_logements_anciens.label: Existing home prices (Notaires-INSEE index, metropolitan France)
fr_prix_logements_anciens.description: The quarterly price index for existing homes, all types, seasonally adjusted, base 100 in 2015.

fr_taux_long_terme.label: France long-term rate (10-year, monthly average)
fr_taux_long_terme.description: The monthly average yield on 10-year French government bonds, as published by the ECB for convergence purposes.

fr_tec10.label: 10-year OAT (TEC 10)
fr_tec10.description: The 10-year constant maturity rate of French government bonds — the benchmark for long-term rates, published every business day.

fr_tem_immo_20ans.label: Average effective rate — fixed-rate mortgages of 20 years and over
fr_tem_immo_20ans.description: The average annual percentage rate of charge on mortgages of 20 years and over granted to individuals during the previous quarter.

fr_usure_immo_10_20ans.label: Usury rate — fixed-rate mortgages of 10 to under 20 years
fr_usure_immo_10_20ans.description: The maximum annual percentage rate of charge at which a mortgage of 10 to under 20 years can be granted this quarter.

fr_usure_immo_20ans.label: Usury rate — fixed-rate mortgages of 20 years and over
fr_usure_immo_20ans.description: The maximum annual percentage rate of charge at which a mortgage of 20 years and over can be granted this quarter.

ze_inflation_ipch.label: Inflation in the euro area (HICP, year on year)
ze_inflation_ipch.description: The rise in harmonized consumer prices over twelve months in the euro area, the one the ECB tracks.

page.aucun_pack_metier_n_est_choisi_757c: No business pack is chosen: these are the “Any profession” indicators. <link>Choose my business</link>.
page.chaque_indicateur_suivi_est_copie_dans_6: Each tracked indicator is copied into the verified figures with its period and its source, updated by each collection run — never by hand. A silent source leaves the last value displayed, with its date.
page.date_ou_periode_telle_qu_on_affe: Date or period, as it’s cited
page.exactement_comme_elle_doit_apparaitre_91: Exactly as it should appear: “910”, “95 %”, “680 M€”.
page.pas_encore_lu_a_la_prochaine_a1d1: Not read yet — at the next collection run.
page.premier_jour_de_la_periode_pour_9b63: First day of the period (for sorting, optional)
page.qui_publie_ce_chiffre_ton_cabinet_be41: Who publishes this figure — your firm for internal data.
page.source_muette_aucune_valeur_encore_lue: Silent source ({lastError}) — no value read yet.
page.source_muette_depuis_derniere_valeur_con: · source silent since ({lastError}): last value kept
page.taux_directeurs_oat_taux_d_usure_0d21: Policy rates, OAT, usury rates, inflation, rent and price indices: official figures (ECB, Banque de France, INSEE, Eurostat), read at the source, dated, and copied into your verified figures so the composer can cite them.
page.tes_propres_chiffres_dossiers_finances_c: Your own figures — loans funded, clients served, assets under management — with their source (you) and the date on which they were true. Without both, the composer won’t cite them.
page.tu_es_en_vue_globale_choisis_d645: You’re in global view: choose an organization in the super admin banner at the top of the screen to see its figures.
page.un_chiffre_sans_source_ou_sans_0ada: A figure without a source or a date is marked “to complete” and isn’t passed to the composer as long as it stays that way — the rule “no figure without its date and its source” applies to internal figures too.
page.description: The single source of the figures the composer is allowed to cite — each with its source and its date. Market indicators copy themselves in, dated and sourced.
